BrochureContent.Content:
A rare opportunity to acquire an exceptional detached family residence standing on approximately 10 acres of prime agricultural land in the picturesque townland of Clonmore. Occupying a prominent position with extensive frontage onto the Castlecomer Road and situated adjacent to the well-known traditional country pub at The Mall, Killeshin, this attractive property combines the tranquillity of country living with excellent connectivity and convenience.

The residence extends over two floors and offers spacious, well-proportioned accommodation ideally suited to modern family life. The ground floor comprises a welcoming porch leading to a generous reception hall, a comfortable sitting room, a separate living room, a bright and versatile artist's studio, kitchen, utility room and guest W.C. Upstairs, there are four spacious bedrooms, including an impressive master suite complete with ensuite bathroom and dressing room, together with a well-appointed family bathroom.

Outside, the property is approached via double access points from the Castlecomer Road, providing excellent accessibility and flexibility. Mature gardens surround the residence, creating a private and peaceful setting enhanced by established trees, shrubbery and colourful planting. A patio area offers the perfect space for outdoor dining and entertaining, while a glass house will appeal to gardening enthusiasts. The adjoining lands are contained within a single, easily managed field and are suitable for both grazing and tillage, offering significant potential for agricultural, equestrian or hobby farming pursuits.

Combining substantial accommodation, mature grounds, quality agricultural lands and a highly accessible location, this outstanding property offers an exceptional lifestyle opportunity in one of the County's most desirable rural settings.
